text:
anya: Quick sync — planning rollout for FlashAttention v2->v3 integration (we're calling the flow "flashsplice"). Goal: enable v3 in paths where it improves latency/cost without regressing short-seq perf. We'll gate by flag and use a runtime chooser with KV-aware heuristics. High-level plan below.

matt: +1. Do we have the profiling from yesterday? I saw ~4-6% token p99 regression on short sequences when v3 was picked with paged-attn fallback.

lee: I ran microbenchmarks this morning — v3 wins for long seqs (>=1024) and sustained throughput, v2 still best for <256. Also noticed KV cache miss rate spikes when mixing paged + fused kernels.

dina: Suggest chooser rules: seq_len <=256 -> flashv2; seq_len >=1024 -> flashv3; 256-1024 -> pick based on sliding window of latency + kv_miss_rate < 2%. Keep the threshold conservative for canary.

anya: Agree. Rollout policy: start canary at 5% traffic, monitor p50/p95/p99, cost per token, and kv_miss_rate. Auto-rollback if p95 increases by >3% or cost increases >5% for 10m.

matt: For feature flags propose:
- flashsplice.mode = runtime | force_v2 | force_v3
- flashsplice.rollout_pct = 5,20,50,100
- telemetry.dimensions = [model, seq_len_bucket, kv_miss_rate_bucket]

lee: I'll add a tiny probe that tags each request with kernel_choice and kv_hit boolean (no prompt text, just metrics). Payload < 40 bytes per request. :eyes:

sre-bot: Please remember to run preflight smoke with replayed traffic on staging before prod canary. Command: `./deploy --tag flashsplice-canary --traffic 5% --replay staging-trace-2026`

dina: rollout config draft:
```json
{
  "mode": "runtime",
  "initial_rollout_pct": 5,
  "buckets": [5,20,50,100],
  "auto_rollback": {
    "p95_delta_pct": 3,
    "cost_delta_pct": 5,
    "window_sec": 600
  }
}
```

matt: Note on batching heuristics: v3 prefers larger microbatch sizes; if we blindly increase batch, tail latency can climb. Add per-model batch_cap and a max_inflight_tokens knob to autobatcher.

anya: ACTIONS: lee = land chooser + probe; matt = wire up flag + rollout scripts; dina = finalize config + rollback alert; I'll book a 30m ops window tomorrow 09:30 UTC and ping @eng-oncall when canary starts.

lee: landed probe in `flashsplice/chooser` branch, open PR: https://git.redwood/flashsplice/PR-142 (small change, metrics only).

matt: Drafting ops playbook now. Immediate step if alarm fires: scale down canary to 0% and flip `flashsplice.mode=force_v2`. If banked rollback fails, revert the service.

deploy-bot: deploy started for tag `flashsplice-canary` -> staging at 4601238000 (jobs: deploy, probe-rollout, smoke-test).

anya: Nice — keep all perf logs and short seq p99s in this thread. If anyone sees kv_miss_rate >3% or sudden p99 jumps call it out immediately. :thumbsup:
